pilot.selection: 60 per source, SHA256 sorting of fixed key and fixed seed before outcome filtering; includes unsupported procedural definitions and duplicates.

coverage.exactBody: Every canonical, variant and repaired original.
coverage.geometry: SVG Hero Patterns plus every safe new candidate. Numeric coordinates/opacity/palette differences collapsed conservatively.
coverage.visual: Every safe new candidate rendered through existing SVG sanitizer at320x200 and compared to every accepted new candidate and every rendered existing Hero/CSS pattern with grayscale spatial correlation.
limitations: Existing CSS/Hero repeat patterns receive elementary-family and actual render screening; exhaustive scale/rotation-invariant rendered matching against all moving assets is not claimed.
Numbered Monster motif families receive one representative, intentionally excluding potentially distinct variants.
Inkjet loops/RNG/branches not executed or reconstructed. Static allow-list extracts authored simple geometry only.
Correlation at one scale does not prove universal visual uniqueness.

qaReproduction.purpose: Local quality-assurance rasters and inert collector source retained outside product data. Original definitions, GLSL fragments, notices, source hashes and collection receipts remain in data/upstream.
qaReproduction.collectorChange: Only repository/lane input and QA raster output paths were updated after relocation. Upstream JavaScript is never imported or executed.
qaReproduction.reproduction: Archived prepare/render Python collectors statically extract stored source and render sanitized local assets with trusted MotionPreview. Matching the historical screen requires the recorded baselineSha256; the current expanded catalog is not that frozen baseline. Manual conservative source-family decisions and canonical input must remain authoritative; collector execution is not automatic integration. Compare reproduced PNG bytes against the per-image SHA256 evidence. Contact sheets are QA composites rather than product previews.
